full_page.content:
1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 12 Cont.
April 23 Conclusion of 40 ho'rs Dev. in 30th St. St.J. Bapt. Church. Fr. Bruno and Solanus with 13 Altar boys went to the procession, all served. They were G. Gorman Ch. O Hara, A. Dempsey, Wm Hayes, Tho's Mullen, Wm Ber- gen, Pat'k Laughlin, F.O Brien, G. Keegan, A Ciralli, Fr Gorman, Jas Smith and John Smith. Some of the boys behaved badly.
April 27 Mr. John King-convert baptised
28 = = = First Holy Communion
M. Christopher Osmore Baptised
May 1st New Rule for Altar boys having been announced the Satur- day before was tried for first time i.e. in order to have the Altar boys give the good example they were to receive at the Holy Mass they served one day at 7 oclock and then serve the next day at 8.
June 2nd First Holy Communion 126 Children received. Same day Fr. Solanus started to say holy Mass at St. Joseph's
9th Grand Corpus Christi - Procession in Monastery Garden - 1st time in afternoon.
Rev. Fr. Theophilus visits Yonkers.
June 26 Graduation exercises in School, Rev. Fr. Halpen from
Page 13
Holy Eucharist Church this city addressed the assembly and 15 graduates.
June 26 Rev. Capistra Claude and Fr. Stephen visited Yonkers - Fr. Stephen conducted retreat for Sisters.
June 24 Altar boys had photo taken
June 30th Only one server at Vesp., D. McCarthy saved the day till 2 students came with censer to the rescue.
